developmentFindings: Required audio correctly closes the source: negative-control test was corrected to poll status instead of heartbeat after closure
Classic ordinary backward command is a relative 2-second jump: test now checks observed position decrease instead of requiring an absolute 2-second target
limitations: Local 20-second fixtures, no real Harvester/network source run
Classic validates native subtitle loading, graph position and data consumption; Qt additionally checks decoded changing pixels, audio and subtitle text
Representative decoder routing regression (H.264 fMP4, VP9 WebM, mixed H.264/Vorbis), not a new full 50-profile decoder qualification
Resource limits, physical A/V drift, large files, hardware/Wayland and remaining expanded TЗ features are not qualified
